# Penguin Original Penguin Premium Blend for Men, 3.4 oz

Launched by the Penguin design house in 2016, this aquatic cologne brings a crisp, clean signature to your daily routine.

## Fresh Notes That Stand Out

Bergamot, apple, and lime open with bright, zesty energy. Sea salt, green notes, and rosemary add a coastal edge, while musk and amber build a warm base that rounds out the blend.

## Long-Lasting Scent for Everyday Wear

This long-lasting fragrance stays with you from morning meetings to evening plans. A spray or two is typically enough, so each bottle goes a long way.

## Suits Every Skin Type

Formulated for all skin types, this cologne fits easily into your routine. Its clean, classic character pairs well with casual outfits and polished looks alike.

## Feel Confident in Every Room

The fresh, appealing scent may help you feel more confident in social settings. Shoppers rate it 4.6 out of 5 across 923 ratings. Add it to your cart today and discover your new everyday scent.
